WHAT: Detailed first-person experience of first week on Concerta 18mg

DAY 1 (noon dose): Reading incredibly easy for first time. Felt 'calm but not high' — Concerta=scalpel vs modafinil=sledgehammer. Felt tiredness for first time (wasn't masked by hyperactivity). High energy but not scattered. Said 'maybe even better than modafinil' by end of day.

DAY 2: Less magic than day 1 — 'just normal.' That IS the goal. Normal feels weird when you've never had it.

DAY 3 (edibles from Friday): Concerta + THC fight. THC wins. Full ADHD scatter, poor memory. Not a fair test.

DAY 4 (Monday): Bad day — hyperactive, can't focus. Woke up late, didn't run. Frustrated, overwhelmed. GYM FIXED IT COMPLETELY. Exercise is the most reliable mood reset — more consistent than meds.

KEY INSIGHT: '18mg is the floor, not the ceiling.' Still scattered but way quieter. Meds raise the floor, don't override everything. Bad days still happen.

GOTCHA: Don't judge the medication on the worst day. 3 good days + 1 rough one = still way better than pre-meds baseline.
